judgment: It is good to use the law courts.
image: So the early kings made punishments clear
and set the laws in order.
lines: He wears fetters for shoes, and his toes are gone.
He bites skin, and his nose is gone.
He bites dried meat, and meets poison.
A little shame, but no harm.
He bites dried meat on the bone —
It is good to hold firm in hardship.
Holding firm: danger, but no harm.
He shoulders fetters, and his ears are gone.

notes.name_en: 噬嗑 is biting and closing the jaws; concrete 'Teeth', not Wilhelm's 'Biting Through'.
notes.L4: 乾胏 dried meat with bone; 金矢 a metal arrow （矢 the whole arrow, as at 40 L2; 'arrowhead' rejected).
